CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Wednesday, March 5, 2025
PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES  Regular Meeting, 6:00 PM

Fabiola Hernandez, Vice Chairmember  Luis Gonzalez, Commissioner
Luis Alvarez, Commissioner  Grant Winford, Commissioner

  Axzel Roman,
  Chairmember

  MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER
The Planning Commission meeting was called to order on Wednesday, March 5, 2025
at 6:01 PM.

FLAG SALUTE
The flag salute was led by Char Roman.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  Commissioner Alvarez
  Commissioner Gonzalez
  Commissioner Winford
  Vice Chairmember Hernandez
  Chairmember Roman
ABSENT
  None
PUBLIC COMMENTS - GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA
There were no Public Comments.

AGENDA ORGANIZATION
There were no changes made to the agenda organization.

REORGANIZATION OF MEMBERS OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION
Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, opened the floor for nominations for Chair.

Commissioner Gonzalez nominated Commissioner Winford for Chair.

Commissioner Winford nominated Vice Chair Hernandez for Chair.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, closed the nominations for Chair.

A motion was made by Commissioner Gonzalez, to nominate Commissioner Winford
for Chair.

AYES: 3; Alvarez, Gonzalez, Roman
NOES: 2; Winford, Hernandez

Motion Carried: 3–2–0–0

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, opened the floor for nominations for Vice Chair.

Chair Roman renominated Vice Chair Hernandez for Vice Chair.

A motion was made by Chairmember Roman, to renominate Vice Chair Hernandez for
Vice Chair.

The motion Carried by the following vote:

AYES: 5; Alvarez, Gonzalez, Winford, Hernandez, Roman
NOES: 0;
ABSENT: 0;
RECUSE: 0;

Motion Carried: 5–0–0–0

 A. CONSENT CALENDAR
 1. Recommendation to adopt Planning Commission Resolution No. 2025-001,
  approving (overturning staff’s denial) a Minor Use Permit (PLNG2024-0011-
  MUP), subject to conditions of approval for a proposed boat sales business
  located at 12347 E. Carson Street (“Property”) in the City of Hawaiian Gardens
  (APN: 7066-017-127) and determining that the project is categorically exempt
  from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Chairmember Winford, seconded by Commissioner
  Gonzalez, to adopt the Consent Calendar as presented, in its entirety.

  The motion Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 3; Alvarez, Gonzalez, Roman
  NOES: 2; Winford, Hernandez
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 3–2–0–0

  2.  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission Special
  Meeting of Wednesday, January 29, 2025.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Chairmember Winford, seconded by Commissioner

  The motion Carried by the following vote:

 B. ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)
 There were no Oral Staff Reports.

 C. ORAL COMMISSIONER REPORT(S)
 Chair-elect Winford thanked the commissioners for the Chair nomination.

 D. ADJOURNMENT
 The Planning Commission meeting was adjourned at 6:09 PM.
